# Euronews

> > Euronews is a multilingual European news network providing breaking news coverage across Europe, Middle East, and global affairs through video-on-demand and live news feeds.

Euronews operates in multiple languages including Turkish, German, Russian, and English, delivering comprehensive coverage of international conflicts, economic developments, and political events. The platform offers news through web, mobile apps, and messaging services like Telegram and Viber.

## Key Topics

- Iran-Israel conflicts
- Ukraine crisis
- US-China relations
- European Union politics
- Oil prices and energy markets
- Strait of Hormuz tensions
- NATO developments
- Middle East conflicts
- Russia international relations
- European economic news
- Breaking news coverage
- Multilingual journalism
- Video news reporting

## Regional Homepages

- [Euronews Turkish Homepage](https://tr.euronews.com/): Turkish homepage covering breaking news from Europe, world, economy & politics
- [Euronews German Homepage](http://de.euronews.com/): German homepage with video news on Ukraine, Iran, NATO & European politics

## Live News & Breaking Updates

- [Just IN - Latest News Timeline](https://tr.euronews.com/son-haberler): Live news feed covering Russia, US, China, Iran, Israel conflicts & events
- [Qatar Threatens Retaliation After Iranian Missile Interception](https://ru.euronews.com/2026/02/28/qatar-threatens-retaliation-after-intercepting-third-wave-of-iranian-missiles-over-doha): Qatar condemns Iranian missile strikes over Doha, threatens retaliation

## Podcasts & Audio Content

- [Radio Schuman: New Leader in Iran, Rising Oil Prices](https://podcasts.euronews.com/radio-schuman/202603090734-new-leader-iran-rising-oil-prices-and-europe-alert): Radio Schuman podcast on Iran leadership change, oil prices & Europe tensions

## Access & Distribution

- [Messaging Apps](https://www.euronews.com/messaging-apps): Access Euronews via Telegram & Viber multilingual messaging channels
